side.label: Portrait side
side.note: Which side the portrait sits on when there is room for two columns. On a phone it always comes first, as a short strip.

start.label: Portrait on the left
start.note: The portrait first, then the words and the sign-up. The default.

end.label: Portrait on the right
end.note: The words and the sign-up first, then the portrait. Use it to swap sides with a photograph further down the page.

rounded.label: Rounded
rounded.note: Rounded corners, a little rounder than your brand's cards. On a brand with square corners it stays square.

arch.label: Arch
arch.note: A half circle across the top, like a window. The same shape on every brand.

half-bleed.label: To the edge
half-bleed.note: The portrait runs to the edge of the screen and the full height of the section, with no corners.

ground.label: Background
ground.note: The colour behind the words and the sign-up. The sign-up card keeps its own card colour on every choice.

plain.label: Default
plain.note: The page's own background colour. Quiet, and the right choice for most pages.

soft.label: Light
soft.note: A soft tint, to set the opener apart from the section under it.

brand.label: Brand colour
brand.note: Your brand colour, with text chosen to stay readable on it. Best used once or twice a page, not on everything.

deep.label: Dark
deep.note: A dark band. The boldest option, and the one that loses its impact if you use it more than once.

motion.label: Movement
motion.note: Whether this section moves as the visitor reaches it. Nothing moves for a visitor who has asked their device for less motion, whichever you pick.

default.label: Still
default.note: Nothing moves. The section is simply there when the visitor arrives, which is the default.

moving.label: Moves
moving.note: The portrait is there from the first moment. The headline, the line under it and the sign-up ease in one after another as the page opens, once, in under a second. It needs the platform's behaviour library; where that is not served the section is simply still.
